from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyDebtRepayment(BaseModel):
    """One company's debt repayment cash from its financial report."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="The company this report belongs to, as named in the document")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")
    debt_repayment_cash: float | None = Field(description="Cash paid for debt repayment; 0 or None if not reported")
    unit: str = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g. '元'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text containing the debt repayment amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_debt_repayments: list[CompanyDebtRepayment]
